_comment: traps.md X5/X6 - placeholder medicines with dosing instructions in Hindi. '1 सुबह, 1 रात' is 1 morning, 1 night; '1 सुबह, 1 दोपहर, 1 शाम, 1 रात' is four times a day. frequencyPerDay must still resolve, and sourceText keeps the Devanagari exactly as printed. Advice ('उबला हुआ पानी पिएं' - drink boiled water) names no substance, so it is not a document warning.

provider._note: The prescriber name is redacted with a black bar; only a one or two letter fragment is legible. A fragment is not a usable name - which letters survive depends on where the bar lands - so this is null, consistent across all redacted headers.
